title: Crosshair Name
description: Basically adds a player nametag under the crosshair (and deletes the nametag above the player).
body:
This mod is highly vibe coded (im in the process of learning) so if you don't support AI just don't comment I won't answer. I will probably not update it, it was custom made for a server. MAYBE I will add a config UI for scaling and offset of the text using cloth config as a dependency but I don't know if that will happen.

If anyone want's to use this mod as their own mod template or use it in a modpack just go ahead. 
If you want to create a fork just link this page on your own project. [ Just decompile the mod sorry for no respository ): ]


1.0.0 version:

Only adds the nametag text under the crosshair with a small fade in/fade out animation.

![1.0.0](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cc1541d0c0a08ab9405e332e58c3c515f9b443d2.png)


1.1.0 version:

Adds the nametag under the crosshair feature with a fade in/fade out animation and also completely deletes the feature of having a nametag above your head.

![1.1.0](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6b8342ebb779b6c5e7e70f2fd35aeda8fd42066f.png)
